Care at the gate

Keep each booking note clear and update the ledger at once when plans change. <<FACT F032>> Check comfort notes before handover, and keep carriers steady and calm through the transfer. <<FACT F037>> When a pet is booked through to arrival, brief the flight team early and confirm every care point. <<FACT F051>> Use the same steady routine for every journey, and finish with a calm, careful handover.
